scenario.name: r-cw-token-bracket
scenario.description: Bracket/token CONTINUE_WORK path: lightContext subagent emits bare CONTINUE_WORK token at end-of-turn, hop-2 drives. Proves the token-form continuation works for subagents (the #952 row lineage).
scenario.registryNotes: Local scratch conversion: runnable k6 scenario exercises lightContext sessions_spawn child emitting bare CONTINUE_WORK:N and requiring TOKEN-HOP2-DONE hop-2 sentinel.

seatClassExpectation.reason: CONTINUE_WORK bare token only fires from auto-delivered final-text (subagent-announce path). On main-session message-body delivery seats, the token scanner doesn't walk the payload. lightContext subagents auto-deliver → scanner fires → hop-2 drives.

expectedReceipts.name: parent-dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: sessions.send dispatch accepted for disposable parent session

expectedReceipts.name: subagent-spawn-requested
expectedReceipts.description: parent instructed to call sessions_spawn lightContext child

expectedReceipts.name: subagent-spawn-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: The parent's sessions_spawn toolResult, bound by toolCallId to the call whose task carries the nonce, answered accepted with a childSessionKey

expectedReceipts.name: token-emitted-or-stripped
expectedReceipts.description: The child's own assistant row (on the childSessionKey from the spawn receipt) says TOKEN-HOP1 <nonce>, and the child made no typed continue_work call

expectedReceipts.name: hop-2-executed
expectedReceipts.description: After a [continuation:wake] row or in a run other than hop 1, the child's own assistant row says TOKEN-HOP2-DONE <nonce> TOKEN <12 chars>, a token minted in hop 2 and absent from every harness-sent text

expectedReceipts.name: parent-return
expectedReceipts.description: The parent reproduces TOKEN-HOP2-RETURN <nonce> TOKEN <hop-2 token> in a run other than the dispatch run, not earlier than the token: hop 2's own result reached the parent

expectedReceipts.name: journal-work-wake-hop-2
expectedReceipts.description: Review receipt: journal [continuation:work-wake] for the child session; runtime labels the first child continuation wake as hop=1/200, which is the semantic hop-2 turn for this row

expectedReceipts.name: tempo-trace-json
expectedReceipts.description: Public-safe Tempo trace JSON (tempo-trace-<id>.json) for the sessions_spawn child whose bare CONTINUE_WORK token drives the continuation.work.fire wake path, collected by collect-continuation-trace.mjs. Formerly spelled tempo-trace; required for every continuation row (#600).

expectedReceipts.name: tool-trace-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: tool-trace-correlation.json: exactly one Tempo trace on this seat inside the row’s evidence window, holding one sessions_spawn tool-execution span. The continuation.work / continuation.work.fire topology under it is reviewed by hand.

review.notes: Token/bracket CONTINUE_WORK path. PASS when hop-2 drives on the subagent. This is the #952 lineage proof — the lightContext bracket path that was broken pre-fix.

census.limits: The census found accepted continuation entry spans carry no origin, session, turn, or run identity, so a token-driven continuation.work span cannot be told apart from a typed one or joined to the child that emitted the token. The collector attributes this row’s trace only by the sessions_spawn tool span on this seat inside the evidence window; the work/fire topology under it is reviewed by hand.

spans.name: openclaw.tool.execution
spans.notes: The sessions_spawn span the collector attributes by seat and window.

spans.name: continuation.work
spans.notes: Token-driven accepted entry. Carries no origin attribute that distinguishes a token from a typed call.

attributes.notes: Emitted today and asserted by collect-continuation-trace.mjs. It is the strongest join currently available and it is not an identity.
Accepted entry spans carry no signal.kind on the census product basis; origin is contracted by R-OBS-CONT-PROVENANCE.
No k6/Project-81 resource or trace marker exists, so this row’s traffic cannot be separated from organic fleet traffic in a later census.

redaction.rule: The trace is published as a public-safe Tempo projection. The token text, child final text, raw nonces, raw session keys, and gateway tokens never enter the artifact.

controls.positive: The lightContext child reaches TOKEN-HOP1 and emits the bare CONTINUE_WORK token, its hop-2 turn emits TOKEN-HOP2-DONE, the journal records the child’s [continuation:work-wake], and one trace on this seat carries the sessions_spawn span inside the row window.
controls.negative: Token parse or strip alone is insufficient, a harness prompt echo cannot satisfy TOKEN-HOP2-DONE, and more than one sessions_spawn trace in the window is refused as ambiguous. No substring of the parent's own sessions_spawn call or stream counts: the spawn task carries TOKEN-HOP1, CONTINUE_WORK and TOKEN-HOP2-DONE, and at F′ every receipt flipped on them (openclaw-bootstrap#1727).

backendUnavailable.notes: A degraded or empty Tempo answer leaves tempo-trace-json and its correlation receipt pending. That is review debt, not evidence that the continuation did not happen, and it never changes the VU verdict.

verdictAuthority.pass: TOKEN-HOP2-DONE from the continuation wake plus the child’s [continuation:work-wake] journal receipt. Behavioral only; the trace receipts decide review completeness, not the verdict.
verdictAuthority.partial: Hop 2 is not observed, or the seat is a message-body seat. A missing or degraded trace keeps the row review-pending without changing its class.
verdictAuthority.fail: Not emitted by this scenario: an incomplete run is PARTIAL-candidate. Neither trace receipt can produce or clear a FAIL.

execution.deterministicK6: r-cw-token-bracket.js spawns a lightContext child that emits the bare CONTINUE_WORK token.
execution.manual: Manual Tempo review confirms the work/fire topology under the sessions_spawn trace.
execution.relationship: The deterministic row owns the verdict. The Tempo trace receipts decide only whether review is complete; manual review corroborates topology and never upgrades a missing receipt.

liveRunSafety.notes: Bare CONTINUE_WORK token row. Prefer OPENCLAW_CREATE_DISPOSABLE_SESSION=true. PASS requires TOKEN-HOP2-DONE plus journal [continuation:work-wake] for the child session (runtime records first child continuation wake as hop=1/200, the semantic hop-2 turn) and Tempo trace; parse/strip alone is insufficient.
